items.title: Vote Direction Arrow
items.alt: A navy arrow reading Vote points right from a red freestanding A-frame stand.
items.description: Cream edging outlines the arrow and its large pale letters against the dark painted wood. Metal fasteners and black rubber feet finish the bright red support beneath the sign.

items.title: Sample Ballot in a Folded Screen
items.alt: An ochre three-panel paper screen surrounds an unmarked Sample sheet with empty oval rows.
items.description: The warm yellow panels fold outward on either side of the pale paper. A narrow heading and simple blank rules keep the practice sheet visible without adding candidate names or completed choices.

items.title: Queue Ticket Dispenser and Bell
items.alt: A red desktop ticket dispenser stands beside a blue service bell and an empty clear tray.
items.description: One blank cream slip extends from the dark opening in the rounded red housing. The bell's silver push button and the low transparent tray balance the compact reception-desk still life.

items.title: Election Day Desk Calendar
items.alt: An Election Day flip calendar with a blank grid stands beside a small brass clock.
items.description: Navy binding rings curl over the cream calendar page above its walnut-colored base. Burgundy tabs edge the blank grid, while the separate round clock supplies the only numbered face in the arrangement.

items.title: Community Debate Lecterns
items.alt: Two empty wooden lecterns with slim microphones stand on a low curved platform.
items.description: A light oak lectern with a curved front faces a darker walnut lectern with square inset panels. Their different silhouettes and inward-facing microphones suggest a shared discussion space without named speakers.

items.title: Voter Information Pamphlet Rack
items.alt: A white freestanding rack labeled Voter Info holds burgundy, green and cream pamphlets in clear pockets.
items.description: The navy header sits above three vertically stacked compartments, each showing a different paper color. Two slim feet extend from the metal base beneath the open-backed display.
